verdict.rationale: The evidence pack refers to stablecoins and blockchains only generically, e.g. accepting stablecoin payments and creating blockchain addresses. It never names USDC, USDT, other specific stablecoins, or any supported networks. Generic stablecoin support does not show that the platform documents which assets and chains a developer can match to customer holdings.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform documents which stablecoins and chains it supports — USDC, USDT and peers across multiple named networks — so I can match what my customers actually hold
